name: LucidPro 50K · $1,200 daily limit
source: Account holder, 2026-09-27, pasted LucidPro 50K's rule table: account size $50,000; profit target $3,000; max loss limit $2,000; daily loss limit $1,200; max size 4 minis or 40 micros -- and said the daily loss limit can be removed as an option. Asked what hitting the daily limit does: it STOPS YOU FOR THE DAY (soft), the account survives. Earlier the same day: no consistency rule and no minimum days. Still INHERITED FROM FLEX and NOT confirmed for LucidPro: the lock (+$2,100 -> +$100 floor), the max loss being EOD-trailing, payout terms, scaling and session rules.
payout_ladder: first cheques capped $2,000, later $2,500; up to 5 payouts then live review; 90/10 split beyond
notes: Contract scaling (funded): start 20 micros, 30 at +$1,000, 40 at +$2,000; 4 minis = 40 micros is the hard cap (eval too). NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning when a ledger exceeds it.
Flat by 16:10 ET, no overnight holds. NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning.
Only the FIRST payout is simulated; the ladder above is informational.
Trailing max loss is measured END OF DAY, not intraday: the floor moves up with EOD peak profit and never moves down.
The floor LOCKS at +$100 once EOD profit reaches +$2,100 — from then on the account cannot be trailed below +$100.
NO consistency rule and NO minimum trading days (account holder, 2026-09-27): `consistency: null` disables the check, `eval_min_days: 1` means a single day that reaches +$3,000 passes.
Payout requires 5 separate days >= $150 AND net > 0. Payout amount is 50% of profit capped at $2,000, so the max payout additionally needs >= $4,000 profit.

SOFT daily loss limit $1,200: a day's loss is capped at -$1,200 (you are closed out and stopped for the day; the account survives). Applied to the eval AND the funded account. BIAS: on daily P&L the sim cannot see intraday; a trade that dipped past -$1,200 and then won is booked as the full win where Lucid would have stopped you out, so the bigger the per-trade stop vs $1,200, the more the pass rate is overstated. The result carries a warning when any single trade lost more than $1,200.

INHERITED, UNCONFIRMED: the lock (lock_at/lock_floor), EOD (not intraday) trailing, payout terms (win_day, payout_win_days, share, cap), scaling and the 16:10 flat rule are Flex's. Confirmed by the account holder: account_size, eval_target, trailing_mll amount, daily_loss_limit, cap_micros (4 minis / 40 micros), consistency null, eval_min_days 1.
disclaimer: Partly confirmed: size, target, max loss, daily limit, max size, no consistency, no minimum days. Verify the lock, trailing type and payout terms against LucidPro's rulebook.
